CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Song of Ascents.
CHAPTER.VERS: Blessed is everyone who fears Jehovah, who walks in His ways.
You shall eat the labor of your hands, you shall be blessed, and it shall be well with you.
Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine inside your house, your children like olive plants around your table.
Behold, thus shall the man be blessed who fears Jehovah.
Jehovah bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
Yea, may you see your childrens children. Peace be upon Israel!
